text.text: Put one blade blank and one to three ingots of the same Tinkers' material into a crafting table to forge a SlashBlade.
Every stat comes from the material's head stats: durability is the material's durability times the blade type factor, attack is the material's attack plus a blade type modifier.
Extra ingots only add durability, ten percent each. They never change the trait.
Different blanks make different blades: a blade blank makes an uchigatana, a shirasaya blank makes a shirasaya.
